description: This is a PHP class file defining the class 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_NonPersistent', which implements an interface for non-persistent storage of user agent data within the Zend Framework's HTTP component. The class provides methods to check if the storage is empty, read, write, and clear the stored data, and is designed for per-request usage where data does not persist across multiple requests.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_NonPersistent
classes.description: A class providing non-persistent, per-request storage for user agent data, implementing the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage interface.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the storage is empty.
